title: Electric Low Pressure 60 Catalogue Row
seoTitle: Electric Low Pressure 60 | Pinjin 75 kW 35 m³/h Xingtai
description: Electric Low Pressure 60 (Electric 75-60) is a Xingtai electric trailer pump: 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.5 m³, fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm 100 m / 300 m, 24 mm 80 m / 240 m, Kawasaki double pump 100, 3500 kg. It is not Electric 60 at 90 kW.

answerBlock.what: Electric Low Pressure 60 Concrete Pump is an electric low-pressure trailer concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: Electric 75-60, 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.5 m³, fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 100 m / 300 m, 24 mm stone 80 m / 240 m, Kawasaki double pump 100, 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm, 3500 kg. It is not Electric 60 (90 kW, 40 m³/h) and not a boom pump.
answerBlock.who: Grid sites matched to 35 m³/h, 30 MPa and fine stone 150 m / 350 m on a 3500 kg trailer at 75 kW.
factors: 75 kW / 35 m³/h versus Electric 60 at 90 kW / 40 m³/h
Fine stone 150 / 350 m versus 24 mm stone 80 / 240 m on the same page
Hopper 0.5 m³ and Kawasaki double pump 100
An Alibaba 90 kW trailer title is not this 75 kW cell

faqs.question: Is Electric Low Pressure 60 the 90 kW trailer on the Alibaba showroom?
faqs.answer: No. Low Pressure 60 prints 75 kW and 35 m³/h. Electric 60 prints 90 kW and 40 m³/h. A March 2025 Alibaba listing title reads 6013 electric trailer pump 90 kW. That title is not the 75 kW row.

faqs.question: Does Low Pressure 60 print one distance for every stone size?
faqs.answer: No. Fine stone is 150 m / 350 m. 13 mm stone is 100 m / 300 m. 24 mm stone is 80 m / 240 m. Match the stone to the printed pair.
